maya_k: Heads-up: final onsite for SRE candidate next Wed 4/23 2pm PT. Panel currently Sam, Ryan, Natalie. Can you confirm availability? need a scribe + debrief lead. :raising_hand:
Sam: I can do 2pm. happy to be debrief lead if nobody else volunteers.
Ryan: I’m out that day 😕 — can do 3pm or Thu morning. cc @natalie
Natalie: 2pm works for me. I can be scribe if Sam leads debrief.
maya_k: Okay noted — @ryan are you able to switch with Sam for technical deep dive? Sam can cover infra + debrief, Ryan can do system design slot at 3pm? I can ask candidate about time flexibility.
Ryan: If candidate can shift to 3pm that's fine. If not, I can join remotely for my slot at 2pm and skip the final wrap.
ana_peopleops: People Ops here — quick reminder: please use the updated debrief rubric (v2) linked: https://intranet.redwood/ops/rubric-v2 and fill score sheet before EOD. Also we need a headcount for rooms.
Sam: Thanks @ana_peopleops. One quick rubric Q: should 'system availability' be weighted 25% or 15%? The doc shows both in different places.
ana_peopleops: Good catch — weighting is 20% for availability. I'll fix the doc. For scoring, normalize to 100 and add comment if <8 on any core area.
Natalie: Scribe checklist: take 5 bullet points per interviewer + note candidate questions and red flags. I'll prep a template.
maya_k: Zoom link: https://zoom.us/j/123456789 passcode: redwood-sre — I'll ping calendar once candidate confirms 3pm or 2pm.
Ryan: If we go 3pm, @sam can you confirm you're OK to move your calendar? if not I'll remote in.
Sam: Yep I can move — thx. Also quick CR ping: candidate asked to see a small infra code sample. Can we send a sanitized gist? @eng-security any flags?
eng-security: Please scrub any internal IPs/credentials. Recommend using this template: `git diff --staged --stat` + sanitized logs. Send as private gist.
maya_k: Thanks all. I'll update calendar and post final plan here. :thumbsup:
